comment: grid_version 5 occupancy masks, generated by server/tools/island_masks.py from the painted WebP alpha (do not edit by hand). Key building:<B>:<stage> / decor:<item>; decor:?special = an unknown place_* item, decor:? = any other unknown item (both drawn as the signpost). lands[L].size = sprite box side as a fraction of the island width on land stage L; mask = [di, dj] lattice offsets from the spot (the sprite's foot, dj < 0 = further up the screen) holding opaque pixels; base = the ground part that must stand on buildable land (for the harbour: rows above the spot; the spot is a coast cell with water in front, berth = [0, 1]).
